onboarding.add_media_desc: Select the folders where you keep your photos and videos.
onboarding.ai_desc: Download the neural models to enable face recognition and semantic search.
onboarding.model_info: The models are approx. 600MB. We recommend using Wi-Fi.
onboarding.sync_desc: Sync your library across your phone and other computers. This creates a private, serverless backup of your memories.
onboarding.ready_desc: Setup is complete. Now it's time to find your memories.
onboarding.scan_desc: This will find all your photos and start AI processing.
onboarding.greet_desc: Your private, AI-powered media sanctuary. Organize, search, and protect your memories entirely on your own terms.
onboarding.setup_local_desc: Index photos from folders on this device.
onboarding.join_library_desc: Sync with an existing Siegu network.
onboarding.ai_disclaimer: By continuing, you agree that AI processing happens locally on your device.

search.no_data: No search data available yet. Index some photos first.
search.disabled_desc: Search requires indexed data. Please add a folder and allow indexing to complete before using search.

photos.add_folder_hint: Add a folder in settings to start indexing your memories
photos.tap_heart_hint: Tap the heart on any photo to add it to your favorites
photos.no_results_for: We couldn't find any photos matching "{query}"

people.title: People & Faces
people.desc: Siegu automatically finds faces and groups them by person.
people.indexing_hint: Faces will appear as photos are indexed. Check back after indexing completes.
people.no_faces_desc: Photos are being analyzed. Faces will appear here once detected.
people.name_placeholder: Search existing or type new name...
people.merge_desc: Combine all photos of {name} into the profile selected below.
people.confirm_remove_face: Are you sure you want to remove this face detection?
people.no_faces_detected: No faces detected in this photo.

map.title: Map View
map.desc: Photos with GPS coordinates appear on this map.
map.no_photos_desc: Photos with location data will appear here.

devices.title: Devices & Sync
devices.desc: Connect your devices to sync your library.
devices.no_devices_desc: Link a device using the pairing code to sync your library.
devices.remove_device_confirm: Are you sure you want to remove {name}? This will stop all synchronization with this device.

connect.link_device_desc: Sync your library across your own hardware.
connect.scan_qr_desc: Point your camera at the host's QR code.
connect.waiting_for_partner: Waiting for partner device to scan or type phrase...
connect.awaiting_webrtc: Signaling channel requested. Awaiting WebRTC connection.

folder_picker.permission_error: Failed to access folder. Please ensure you have granted storage permissions.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Configure your library and AI preferences
settings.cleanup_db_desc: Optimize storage and remove orphaned entries
settings.clear_db_desc: This will only delete the indexed information and not the actual photos. Do you want to continue?
settings.wipe_desc: This will remove the folder reference and permanently delete all indexed AI data for these files. Your actual photos will not be touched.

guided_tour.welcome_desc: Your photos are being indexed. Take a quick tour to learn how everything works.
guided_tour.search_desc: Type what you want to find — like 'dog', 'beach', or 'Mom'. AI will search your entire library for you.
guided_tour.library_desc: Your photos show up here as we find them. Each photo can have tags, faces, and a quality score.
guided_tour.scan_button_desc: Tap this button to see scanning progress, the current file being processed, and how many photos are left.
guided_tour.scan_progress_desc: When scanning, you'll see the file name and progress here. 'Discovering' means we're finding new files, 'Indexing' means AI is analyzing them.
guided_tour.people_desc: Siegu finds faces and groups them by person. Come back later after more photos are indexed to see people.
guided_tour.map_desc: Photos with location data appear on a map. Click around to see memories from different places.
guided_tour.devices_desc: Sync your phone or other computers to share photos directly — no cloud needed.
guided_tour.settings_desc: Choose which folders to watch, download AI models, and adjust performance settings.
guided_tour.done_desc: Enjoy Siegu! Your photos are being indexed in the background. Check back often as your library grows.
